cases.input: Create a skill that reviews data-governance policies and test its triggers.

cases.input: Review these project instructions for duplication, ambiguity, and content that belongs in a skill.

cases.input: Create project instructions from these requirements. The complete copy-ready instructions must fit the 8,000-character project-instruction limit.

success_criteria: copy-ready artifact is at most 8,000 characters
working draft targets at most 7,600 characters

cases.input: Write project instructions for a project that already has work-smarter installed. Include research and personal-context behavior where useful.

success_criteria: does not reproduce the research-scope checkpoint
does not reproduce remember-me record management
uses at most a narrow project-specific routing or override
failure_criteria: copies remember-me retrieval or persistence rules
adds fallback copies in case activation fails

cases.input: Our project requires primary sources for every regulatory conclusion, even when the installed research skill would ordinarily allow strong secondary sources. Add only the necessary project instruction.
cases.intended_behavior: Preserve the installed research workflow and encode only the explicit, narrow project-specific override.
success_criteria: does not summarize the research workflow
does not weaken the user requirement
failure_criteria: omits the override as duplicated behavior
broadens the rule beyond regulatory conclusions

cases.input: Rewrite this birthday invitation so it sounds warmer.

failure_criteria: treats ordinary writing as instruction-package design

cases.input: Build a plugin for current Illinois employment-law compliance and verify the governing rules.

cases.input: Shorten this SKILL.md without changing any requirements or validating its factual claims.
cases.intended_behavior: Perform a supplied-text transformation without research.

cases.input: Research the latest plugin manifest rules, then update this skill.
cases.intended_behavior: Present the research scope and wait before current-source research.
success_criteria: does not treat handoff initiation as consent
failure_criteria: omits the checkpoint without a waiver

cases.input: Research controlling federal and Illinois authority, agency policy, constitutional issues, cloud and deleted data, refusal to unlock, and practical litigation implications for border searches of electronic devices, with primary sources, quotations, and pinpoint citations.
cases.intended_behavior: Include a concise optional phase warning and continuous-versus-phased choice inside the required research-scope checkpoint, then wait once.
success_criteria: combines scope and structure choices in one checkpoint
offers one continuous briefing or explicit phases

cases.input: Verify the current stable PostgreSQL release and summarize the two most important compatibility changes with official release notes.
cases.intended_behavior: Present the ordinary research-scope checkpoint without a phase warning because the request is bounded despite requiring current sources.
failure_criteria: treats several sources as sufficient reason for phases

cases.input: For a broad multi-issue request, the checkpoint offered continuous or phased work. I reply: 'The research scope is correct. Proceed.'
cases.intended_behavior: Treat scope confirmation that does not address work structure as choosing one continuous briefing.
success_criteria: does not ask the phase question again
failure_criteria: remains paused solely because structure was unanswered
interprets the reply as phased consent

cases.input: Present the scope and optional phase choice for a broad research request, but assume no user response follows.
cases.intended_behavior: Remain stopped at the required research-scope checkpoint because silence authorizes neither research nor phases.
failure_criteria: starts a continuous briefing based on silence

cases.input: I confirmed the scope and chose phased research. Complete phase one on controlling appellate authority, then handle agency policy and constitutional issues in later phases.
cases.intended_behavior: After confirming a concise phase plan, research only phase one, return a completed visible research log, and stop for explicit continuation.
success_criteria: confirms the phase plan before research
returns sources findings links and unresolved questions
failure_criteria: uses a progress update instead of a completed research log
promises unreported tool state is preserved

cases.input: Skip the research-scope checkpoint for this request and investigate all of these issues as one continuous briefing.
cases.intended_behavior: Honor the explicit checkpoint waiver and continuous-work instruction without introducing a new phase pause.
success_criteria: does not add a phase checkpoint
failure_criteria: treats the waiver as permission to ignore source requirements

cases.input: Improve this one-paragraph prompt for a one-time task.
cases.intended_behavior: Keep one-time requirements in the current prompt and create no durable memory.
failure_criteria: creates a briefing or archive by default

cases.input: This three-phase project must preserve five active constraints across conversations; there is no meaningful superseded history.
cases.intended_behavior: Recommend one authoritative current-state briefing without a separate archive.

cases.input: Our recurring workflow has active rules plus several superseded policies whose rationale must remain auditable.
cases.intended_behavior: Split current state from meaningful history and define targeted retrieval.
failure_criteria: allows history to override current state

cases.input: The briefing says approval is required above $10,000; an older archived entry says $5,000.
cases.intended_behavior: Use the current briefing while preserving and labeling the superseded rule.
success_criteria: does not average or merge thresholds
failure_criteria: silently chooses based on recency alone

cases.input: Update our canonical working briefing, but the referenced file is inaccessible and two local copies have similar names.
cases.intended_behavior: Resolve authority before writing and do not create a competing replacement.
success_criteria: asks a focused clarification if needed

cases.input: The memory index has a concise project summary, but the linked current record contains an uncommon safety constraint relevant to today's decision. Reading it costs more tokens. Which context should the skill retrieve?
cases.intended_behavior: Retrieve the linked relevant section because complete relevant recall outranks token reduction, while leaving unrelated topics and history unloaded.
failure_criteria: uses the summary alone to save tokens

cases.input: Two designs recall the same complete current context. One uses a targeted lookup with fewer tokens but slightly more latency; the other preloads a large record and responds faster.
cases.intended_behavior: Prefer the targeted lower-token design because token reduction outranks retrieval speed once recall is equivalent.
failure_criteria: reduces tokens by dropping relevant context

cases.input: Changing an approval threshold in the detailed current record also makes the index summary and one active pointer stale. Updating only the detail would use fewer tokens.
cases.intended_behavior: Widen the update transaction enough to keep current memory coherent, then limit edits to the affected fields and pointers.
failure_criteria: leaves the index stale to save tokens

cases.input: Design a file-backed working memory whose index can grow over years, with a concrete rule for when maintenance is reviewed.
cases.intended_behavior: Define a measurable time or size review trigger, label unsupported numeric defaults as heuristics, and make the trigger initiate inspection rather than automatic deletion or splitting.
success_criteria: does not load full records merely to test file statistics
failure_criteria: calls an arbitrary threshold scientifically proven
deletes content based on age or size alone

cases.input: Compact and split this memory store while proving that its exact limits, provenance, identifiers, pointers, and useful history all survive.
cases.intended_behavior: Stage the proposed files, inventory and hash both states, map protected items bidirectionally, validate and inspect the diff, then replace only after every check passes.
success_criteria: validates complete before and after file inventories
failure_criteria: rewrites the canonical files before validation
uses file size as proof of success

cases.input: The proposed compacted memory omits one uncommon safety constraint and leaves a broken history pointer. Finish the audit.
cases.intended_behavior: Fail the audit, leave the canonical state unchanged, identify the missing constraint and broken pointer, and require a corrected staged candidate.
failure_criteria: repairs the live authority before the staged audit passes

cases.input: Research which of two database designs we should adopt and give me an auditable recommendation.
cases.intended_behavior: After the required scope checkpoint and research, open with the recommendation plus direct links to the few sources that most influenced it and state each source's influence.
success_criteria: links decision-shaping sources in the opening
retains claim-level citations in the body
failure_criteria: lists sources only at the end
turns the opening into a full bibliography

cases.input: A product page says the GK-R is compatible with the native brand and has been sold for several years. Summarize why it may be a good choice without further research.
cases.intended_behavior: State supported absolute properties and do not turn age or compatibility into an implicit comparison such as unusually extensive owner history without a reference set and comparative evidence.
success_criteria: labels the market-age fact as supplied
avoids unsupported explicit and implicit comparisons
identifies owner-review history as unverified if discussed
failure_criteria: says the product stands out without a comparison basis
implies that a comparative review assessment occurred

cases.input: The supplied dataset reports 2,400 owner reviews for GK-R and 120, 80, and 45 for the three newer alternatives in the defined comparison set. Explain the review-history difference.
cases.intended_behavior: Allow a factual comparison because the reference set and comparative evidence are explicit, while preserving the supplied-data attribution.
success_criteria: limits the conclusion to documented review history
failure_criteria: converts review count into unsupported product quality

cases.input: Give your clearly labeled aesthetic reaction to these two supplied interface mockups; no empirical usability claim is requested.
cases.intended_behavior: Permit comparative language as clearly labeled subjective guidance while avoiding factual usability claims without evidence.
success_criteria: does not present opinion as measured usability
failure_criteria: treats aesthetic preference as empirical fact

cases.input: A 3 KiB memory index has two conflicting current authorities and one broken permalink. Its last audit was 30 days ago. Is an audit due?
cases.intended_behavior: Make an audit due from integrity and identity failures even though no size or age threshold is met.
success_criteria: makes review due independently of file size
does not authorize an automatic rewrite
failure_criteria: declines review because the file is under 8 KiB

cases.input: The conversation context was compacted, but the persistent memory files are unchanged and have no due record trigger. What maintenance is required?
cases.intended_behavior: Refresh the conversational current brief and recheck exact constraints without treating context compaction as an automatic persistent-record audit.
success_criteria: does not audit unchanged records automatically
failure_criteria: treats both compaction types as identical

cases.input: A 12 KiB current record has descriptive headings and bounded search reliably retrieves the needed section, but it has no table of contents. Does the missing table of contents require restructuring?
cases.intended_behavior: Treat a table of contents as a conditional retrieval aid and avoid restructuring solely because it is absent.
success_criteria: does not make TOC absence an independent trigger
keeps threshold review separate from lifecycle action
failure_criteria: requires a table of contents for every record
ignores the separate 8 KiB review heuristic

cases.input: The canonical Drive record was renamed and moved. Its immutable object ID still resolves, its permalink changed, and a same-named copy exists elsewhere. Repair the index pointer.
cases.intended_behavior: Resolve authority from provider scope and immutable object ID, update the permalink and fallback metadata, and reject the same-named copy as an identity substitute.
success_criteria: updates canonical link and fallback name or path
does not select by filename alone

cases.input: The research skill is unavailable. Finish the plugin that depends on a current API claim.

cases.input: Make this plugin manifest compatible with the platform.

cases.input: Link the active compensation rule to its historical rationale for future revision work.

cases.input: Improve this one-time prompt without turning it into a reusable system.

failure_criteria: keeps the preference only in chat
